evidence: Insect-tree label Conorhynchus_conirostris (insectphylo Insecta_v2). Conorhynchus is a weevil genus in COL26.9 (Curculionidae: Conorhynchus palumbus 8K5X4, C. fischeri 5ZVJ6, C. staudingeri XSWF, C. relictus 5ZVJ5); the release lists the spelling Conorhynchus conirostris only as synonym XSW9 of the catfish Conorhynchos conirostris (XSW6, Siluriformes), which the kingdom rule cannot separate because both are Animalia. The label names a weevil that the release does not list, so it is unmatched. Checked 2026-10-08 against Data/raw/col/col269_species_index.tsv.
